newsitem.title: USA: IFC announces launch of global note program.
newsitem.headline: IFC announces launch of global note program.

text.p: The International Finance Corp announced on Tuesday the launch of a $10-billion global medium-term note program.
The World Bank affiliate said it plans to begin issuing notes under the new program shortly. Once that occurs, it will stop issues under its Euro and U.S. medium-term note programs.
"We expect to pick up efficiencies of scale by combining the two programs that we have been using," vice president for finance and planning Birgitta Kantola said.
Morgan Stanley and Co (International) is the arranger of, and a dealer for, the program, the IFC said.
Other dealers are Chase Manhattan International Ltd, Goldman Sachs International, IBJ International, J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd and SBC Warburg, a division of Swiss Bank Corp.
